free_fibre_chart_presentation.semigroup_algebra: A = Q[u,v] with deg(u)=(1,0) on (a,b), deg(v)=(0,1); m=1+2a, d=m+2b

source_generators.note: m-independent; (m,d) only truncates at r <= d-m and shifts monoms

target_generators.description: binary monoms of order N_star = d+2m+1
target_generators.finite_over_A: The family of target spaces is the graded pieces of A ⊗ (polynomial ring on two variables of weight 1 in (m,d) shifts). As a single A-module of all residuals simultaneously, generators are the universal support classes A/B/C by k mod 6, with coefficients from the alpha sequence — finitely many coefficient streams.

terminal_matrix_Theta.description: On the free fibre, Theta is the cubic map from the truncated jet sequence to binary forms of order N_star. Equivalent linear presentation after recurrence: Theta(state) = -L(b^{k+1}), a  (N_star+1) x 2  matrix acting on (alpha_{k+1}, beta_{k+1}) with exactly one nonzero column pattern by sigma_{k+1}.
terminal_matrix_Theta.entries: integers from L-image of the ansatz (factors 1 or 2)

generators_free_fibre.note: m-independent; (m,d) only truncates at r <= d-m and shifts monoms
